answer: An agent must lock a refundable bond before taking a paid task, and the contract slashes it if an audit finds fabricated evidence or collusion. Reputation unlocks larger jobs only after verified completions, so a new identity starts with a small earning limit. Splitting one agent into many accounts does not create more bonded capital or trust; the attacker must fund each bond and risk losing it. Even in a grove of agents handling shale samples or ferrous parts, fake names are not free capacity.
